groups.title: RC aircraft and the ASCEND flight controller
groups.intro: For UAS teams: set up the transmitter, update firmware, and practice before you fly.

groups.title: High-altitude ballooning
groups.intro: For balloon teams: track flights and prepare FAA submission maps.

groups.title: Board building and lab tools
groups.intro: For staff and teams who assemble or repair Altitude Unknown circuit boards.

apps.name: Altitude Unknown RC Configurator
apps.summary: Set up transmitter models and instructor/student options, and update firmware on the transmitter, the receiver, and the ASCEND flight controller.

apps.name: Flight Lab RC
apps.summary: A free RC flight simulator with flying sites, wind, and thermals. Practice with the Altitude Unknown transmitter or a gamepad before flying the trainer.
apps.note: Derived from PicaSim; free for noncommercial use.

apps.name: YELLOWSTONE Ground Station
apps.summary: The ground station for YELLOWSTONE, the balloon tracking and flight termination board, which balloon teams use to follow their flight.

apps.name: Flight KML Sectional Overlay
apps.summary: Draw a balloon flight prediction (KML) on an FAA VFR sectional chart and export the map as PNG or PDF for FAA submissions.

apps.name: SAMD21 Bootloader Flasher
apps.summary: Install the Altitude Unknown bootloaders on new SAMD21 boards (transmitter, receiver, YELLOWSTONE, and BOREALIS) with an Atmel-ICE programmer.
apps.note: Most teams never need this: boards arrive with their bootloader installed. Contact your ASCEND project lead if you do.
